title: King Iohn
summary: Raleigh names King Iohn in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). King Iohn, who charged the black Prince neere Poitiers. The one-word title would not say which Iohn, so the title is two words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter II, §. III, sig. 468b–469a
